claim: the identity-shaped actions: edit an employee record, edit your own profile, and submit the public contact form into CRM

checks.name: HR sees the employee edit form
updateEmployee persists the new job title
the profile form is pre-filled from the database
clearing the phone stores null, not an empty string
the contact form confirms receipt to the enquirer
the lead is sourced from the website form
the lead lands in the sales queue as new
a honeypot submission is told it succeeded
a honeypot submission writes no lead
an invalid email is refused at step 1
no lead is written for invalid input

notes: This proves CLIENT-side validation: the input is type=email with required, so the browser blocks the submit and contactAction is never called. The server-side contactSchema rejection path is not exercised here, because the UI cannot reach it.
